provenance_note: Curated developability liabilities, keyed by UniProt accession and/or InterPro family. Authoritative when present: a documented liability overrides the sequence predictor (fail-closed demote). EVERY record MUST carry a verifiable primary citation (PMID or DOI) with an exact quote -- claims from memory are not admissible. Family-keyed records transfer to unannotated homologs, like the reaction coordinates.

corrections.reason: Unsupported by the literature. The claim originated from project memory, not a citation. A targeted primary-literature search found NO report of PylC insolubility, aggregation, poor expression, or a refolding requirement. The opposite is documented.

refuting_evidence.citation: Quitterer F, List A, Beck P, Bacher A, Groll M. J Mol Biol 2012;424(5):270-82 (PDB 4FFL)
refuting_evidence.quote: Here, we present six crystal structures of the monomeric active ligase in complex with substrates, reaction intermediates, and products...
refuting_evidence.note: PylC was expressed in E. coli BL21(DE3)/pET28b (His-tagged, per PDB 4FFL deposition) and purified well enough for six 1.5 A co-crystal structures; the paper also notes a nucleotide is 'responsible for protein stability'. No solubility problem is reported.
